primitives.name: Evidence Vault Compliance
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## Section 1 — Fine-Tuning Prerequisites Fine-tuning may NOT begin until ALL of the following are true: ### Prerequisite 1 — Evidence Vault Exists and Is Populated Fine-tuning on sports intelligence data requires a curated dataset of high-quality sports intelligence inputs and outputs.
primitives.assumptions: All inputs are T1/T2 quality; no synthetic data allowed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: E_v = 1 iff all evidence items are verified and licensed.

layer2.mapping: Evidence vault compliance maps to a probabilistic constraint on input data quality, ensuring that model training is conditioned on real-world sports facts.
layer2.telemetry: Verification of T1/T2 data sources and licensing status.

primitives.name: Hallucination Baseline
primitives.verbatim_quote: --### Prerequisite 3 — Hallucination Tests Exist and Pass for the Base Model Before fine-tuning, establish a baseline: how often does the base model hallucinate sports facts?
primitives.assumptions: Base model output is evaluated against known facts; hallucination rate is measurable.
primitives.breakdown_regime: H_0 < threshold implies acceptable starting point for fine-tuning.

layer2.mapping: Hallucination baseline defines a kernel of trustworthiness for model evolution; fine-tuning must not increase H_0 beyond safety thresholds.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of false fact assertions in controlled test sets.

primitives.assumptions: Scanner is active on all content paths; no bypasses allowed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: C_g = 1 iff scanner is verified active across all generation paths.

layer2.mapping: Governance scanner enforces a logical filter on model outputs, aligning with GSE's state-transition logic where each claim must be validated before propagation.

The fine-tuning governance framework establishes four core constraints: evidence vault integrity, hallucination control, claim validation, and licensing compliance. These form a dual structure where each constraint acts as both a necessary condition and a safety layer. The evidence vault ensures data fidelity, while hallucination tests provide a baseline for truthfulness. The claim governance scanner functions as a post-processing filter that enforces semantic correctness. Licensing compliance ensures legal alignment. Together, these primitives define a constrained optimization space where model behavior is bounded by empirical and ethical criteria. Failure in any one constraint leads to rejection of the fine-tune. This structure mirrors a Bayesian belief update where prior knowledge (evidence vault) is refined under constraints (hallucination, governance, licensing), producing a posterior model that satisfies all safety conditions. The dual nature of these constraints—both enabling and constraining—creates a robust feedback loop that prevents degradation of model integrity.
